description.en:
Cyborg-R01 is Cyborg Robotics' full-size bipedal humanoid platform. It sits within the company's focus on embodied robots for demanding industrial environments, where mobility, perception and physical interaction are combined to support inspection and operational work.

Cyborg identifies electricity, gas, petroleum, chemicals, mining and heavy industry as target sectors for its robotics systems. The bipedal platform provides a basis for developing tasks in spaces organized around human workers. Its actual inspection instruments, end effectors and software are application-dependent; the company also supports research, training and data-collection uses across its product portfolio.
description.zh: 面向高危巡检和重载工业作业的全尺寸双足人形机器人，融合高负载、多模态感知与快速换电能力。
